column5: For things to work effectively, order and solid structure are essential. Without them, disorder and chaos can easily arise. That is why building a strong foundation of doctrine is paramount to living fully as a healthy Christian.

column4: That's why "*Principles of Faith*" will serve as a powerful resource for believers. From the very first chapter, which addresses the importance of sound doctrine, to the rest of the over 300 pages filled with teachings and activities about the church and our roles within it, as well as understanding and recognizing God's voice, this book is invaluable. It will be an exceptional tool in the classroom for teaching and preparing leaders with a solid foundation in doctrine, while also being highly beneficial for individual readers.
